required_stages.description: Allocate a fresh (N, N) output of A's dtype inside run().
One kernel pass that reads every element of A exactly once and writes it unchanged to the same position of the output, with correct tail handling for N*N elements.

forbidden_substitutions.message: The copy must be performed by the kernel, not by a PyTorch clone/copy.
Returning the input or a view of it violates the fresh-output requirement.
Host-side arithmetic identity on the input replaces the whole computation.
No dtype conversion is allowed anywhere in matrix_copy.
No initialised scratch buffer is part of this operator; only torch.empty / torch.empty_like are expected.

required_evidence.message: No kernel-level store found; the copy must be done by a kernel.

outputs.aliasing: none; the returned (N, N) tensor must be freshly allocated inside run() and must not share storage with A

timing_boundary.notes: Everything inside run() is timed: the output allocation, optional metadata-only flatten views, and the single copy kernel. No cached state, no untimed prepacking, no host-side copies.
